name: AIazing Security AI
summary: Local lab and verified HTTP assessments work. AI inference and training are not connected.
current_focus: Local dashboard for observing assessments and reviewing evidence.
next_step: Define the model observation/action interface and self-hosted inference adapter.

phases.title: Reproducible testing lab
phases.detail: Two synthetic accounts, vulnerable/fixed applications, reset, and independent controls.

phases.title: Assessment engine
phases.detail: HTTP collection, authorization, limits, verification, and JSON exports work for the lab. Browser containment and OS isolation remain.

phases.title: Self-hosted model baseline
phases.detail: Model interface, base-model/hardware selection, and local inference are next.

phases.title: Web research preview
phases.detail: Local dashboard supports live assessments, findings, evidence, and downloads. Customer accounts and production hosting remain.

phases.title: Our specialized model
phases.detail: Reviewed training episodes, fine-tuning, and held-out comparisons follow the baseline.

phases.title: Hosted customer pilot
phases.detail: Customer authorization, tenant isolation, operations, and a limited authorized pilot.
